relevance_note: The single patient described has a DNASE2 variant ("a homozygous missense variant in the DNASE2 gene"), and the paper never mentions TNFAIP3, A20 or HA20, so it describes no in-scope person.
method_note: Read the full paper manually. A case-insensitive search for 'TNFAIP3', 'A20', 'HA20' and 'haploinsufficiency' found no matches. The patient is a 15-year-old boy with homozygous DNASE2 NM_001375.2:c.1040G>A (p.Cys347Tyr), a monogenic type-1 interferonopathy treated with anifrolumab. Under the v3 scope rule he and his relatives (his mother with autoimmune hypothyroidism, a healthy 7-year-old sibling) get no rows, so the individuals, variants, phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist tables are empty. cohort_size_as_stated = 1 comes from the case-report framing ('We present a 15-year-old boy'); the authors give no explicit cohort count. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null because the paper says nothing either way about earlier reports of this patient. n_patients_reported is null because the authors state no number of TNFAIP3-variant patients. No contradictions found.
